seoTitle: Physical Therapy in Oshkosh, WI | Fox Valley Physical Therapy
seoDescription: One-on-one physical therapy in Oshkosh since 1990, with the only therapeutic pool in town. No referral needed, and most insurance accepted.
heroText: Locally owned since 1990, with the only therapeutic pool in Oshkosh. No referral needed, and we take most insurance, including Medicare.
approachTitle: A Better Approach To Physical Therapy
approachText: Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness Clinic started in a 500 square foot office in 1990. Today it's a 7,500 square foot clinic with a therapeutic pool and a fully equipped gym, and a team with more than 100 years of combined experience. What hasn't changed is how we treat people.
approachCaptionText: "I treat their injuries as if they were my injuries."

benefits.title: One-On-One, Every Visit
benefits.text: At every appointment you get hands-on, one-on-one attention from your therapist.

benefits.title: No Referral Needed
benefits.text: Call and schedule directly — we'll check your insurance benefits for you.

benefits.title: The Only Therapeutic Pool In Oshkosh
benefits.text: Aquatic therapy for arthritis, joint replacements, balance and pain, right here in the clinic.

benefits.title: We Talk To Your Doctor
benefits.text: We keep your physician in the loop and call them if your plan needs to change.

teamText: Physical therapists, an occupational therapist, a physical therapist assistant and a licensed athletic trainer, with more than 100 years of combined experience.
poolTitle: The Only Therapeutic Pool In Oshkosh
poolText:
Warm water takes weight off healing joints, so you can start moving and strengthening sooner and with less pain. It's a great fit for arthritis, rehab after surgery or joint replacement, balance problems and chronic back pain.

Finished with therapy? Current and former patients can reserve the pool on their own for {poolPrice} a month.
visitTitle: Visit Us At Our Oshkosh Location
visitText: Free parking right out front on S Washburn Street. Download the intake form ahead of time to save a few minutes at check-in.
